personalization.engagementGoal: We doubled in two years and the way we run the company didn't keep up. Finance, sales and operations each show me a different quarter, decisions wait for a meeting that waits for a report, and nobody owns the hand-offs between teams. I want one operating picture and a plan my team can actually run.
